title: Windows-UAC-Research-Catalog
scope: Historical ten-repository snapshot; author claims not independently tested.

repositories.name: metaltroop/RENI
repositories.description: 🖥️📱 RENIS // RENIC — Self-hosted remote desktop engine & mobile PWA with WebAuthn fingerprint auth, UAC-bypassing admin execution, live hardware telemetry, and real-time binary screen streaming.
repositories.summary_en: RENI combines the RENIS server and RENIC mobile client. Its author describes WebAuthn authentication, hardware telemetry, and real-time screen streaming alongside elevated administration features.

repositories.name: slabbayak-223211-bot/uac-bypass-toolkit-v1-1
repositories.description: Skip UAC Prompt 1.1 Workaround Guide for Windows 2026
repositories.summary_en: The repository describes itself as a “Skip UAC Prompt 1.1 Workaround Guide for Windows 2026.” Review its contents and the destination of any external download links before relying on promotional claims.

repositories.name: Krwozer/ShellCode-Elevator-Uac-Bypass-Inject-Any-X64-fud
repositories.description: Shellcode development involves creating payloads for post-exploitation tasks like antivirus evasion and UAC bypass. Tools like shellcode loaders and injectors enable execution, while assembly and encoders ensure stealth on Windows systems.
repositories.summary_en: The author describes a project involving shellcode loaders, injection, and UAC-related behavior. Claims about stealth or antivirus evasion are not validated by inclusion in this catalog.

repositories.name: Ecerstm/CMSTPLua-Reflective-UAC-Bypass
repositories.description: Windows UAC bypass tool using the DLL injection technique. It loads the DLL entirely from memory without touching the disk.
repositories.summary_en: The repository describes a Windows UAC-related tool that loads a DLL from memory. Its documentation includes an overview, requirements, and technical discussion.

repositories.name: owlsecx/OUACBypass
repositories.summary_en: OUACBypass presents itself as a catalog of UAC bypass techniques. It provides a starting point for identifying research topics, rather than proof that any technique applies to every Windows configuration.

repositories.name: wesmar/WinDefCtl
repositories.description: Command-line utility to completely halt, disable, and neutralize Windows Defender and Tamper Protection. Bypasses forced UAC and GUI requirements in Windows 11 (supports 26H1/26H2). Features invisible execution and automatic privilege handling. Essential tool for sysadmins and security researchers.
repositories.summary_en: The author describes a command-line utility affecting Windows Defender and Tamper Protection. Because the stated functionality changes security controls, evaluation requires particular care and a recoverable, isolated environment.

repositories.name: MemDecompression/iscsicpl-uac-bypass
repositories.description: Still working on Windows 11 26H2 and undetected by wd
repositories.summary_en: The repository’s brief description includes claims about Windows 11 26H2 compatibility and Windows Defender detection. These remain author statements, not independently confirmed results.

repositories.name: x0xr00t/Automated-MUlti-UAC-Bypass
repositories.summary_en: The project describes automation across several Windows and Windows Server versions. Its stated platform coverage should not be interpreted as a verified compatibility matrix for current builds.

repositories.name: tonykcmarsh/SspiUacBypass
repositories.description: Bypassing UAC with SSPI Datagram Contexts
repositories.summary_en: The repository describes research connecting SSPI Datagram Contexts with UAC bypass behavior. Consult the original project for its scope, dependencies, and limitations.

repositories.name: tonykcmarsh/SharpBypassUAC
repositories.summary_en: SharpBypassUAC is described as a C# tool for UAC bypasses. Its README includes parameter documentation and detection-related sections that may inform defensive review.
